idea-plugin.name: Java Composition — Concise Method Bodies
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for concise method bodies (JEP 8209434) in IntelliJ IDEA: the T m() -> expr; and T m() = ref; forms.
Compilation is handled by the java-composition Maven preprocessor; this plugin provides the live-editor experience — highlighting the concise markers, suppressing the false errors IntelliJ's Java parser would otherwise report, and making concise methods count as interface implementations.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0 — Initial release. Per-method concise bodies (-> and =): marker highlighting, suppression of the parser's false errors, and recognition of concise methods as interface implementations. Wildcard delegation (Map::* = store::*) is not yet supported.
